subject: ScaleOps Peer Forum — Featured Customer Panel Invitation
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena@scaleops.com>, press@scaleops.com
Date: 2025-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. We’re running the ScaleOps Peer Forum (in-person in SF, Nov 12) and putting together a short customer panel (30–40 mins) on productionizing LLMs at scale. ScaleOps is keen to have a Redwood customer on stage to discuss the migration to dedicated serving and the economics/latency wins.

Would Redwood be interested in nominating a speaker to speak alongside two operator customers? We’d love someone who can cover: a) why you chose a dedicated inference strategy, b) measurable cost/latency wins, and c) pitfalls to avoid during rollout.

We can accommodate a joint pre-brief call and cover travel + a modest honorarium. Attached is the panel brief.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Community, ScaleOps
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Sam — thanks for the invite and the brief. We’re interested.

Quick notes: Lauren and Ben are copied — Lauren can speak to the customer rollout story and metrics; I’ll join to cover the architecture tradeoffs and dedicated deployment economics. Marissa, would you like to handle media/speaking logistics?

Can we pencil a 30 min pre-brief the week of Sep 22? I’ll also attach a short speaker bio and a high-level outline we can use.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer GTM — Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-05T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Hi Sam — excited to join. A few practical asks up front:

- Panel length: is 30–40 mins including audience Q&A?
- AV needs: will there be mics for two speakers and one moderator?
- Recording: will ScaleOps record and share the session?

I’ve sketched a 12‑minute narrative: (1) problem we were solving, (2) pilot -> dedicated transition, (3) quantifiable wins (p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost/unit), (4) one failure/lesson. If that works I’ll prepare a one‑page case summary for your kit.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena@scaleops.com>, press@scaleops.com
Date: 2025-09-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Thanks — great outline. Confirming: 35 mins total with 10 mins for audience Q&A. We will provide mics for both speakers + a moderator, and we’ll record and share the session.

Can we lock the pre-brief for Tue Sep 23 at 10:00 PT? I’ll send a calendar invite and include the moderator (Elena) and our events lead.

Also, quick note on logistics — we’ll need a 200–300 word blurb and a headshot for the event page, plus any company logos.

Sam
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-10T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Hi Sam — thanks, looping marketing in. Attached: speaker bio for Rishi, a 220‑word blurb for the event page, and our preferred logo files.

A couple of items for the pre-brief: please share the moderator questions in advance (we’ll prep short talking points), and confirm the recording/posting timeline — we typically link the recording to our case study within two weeks after the event.

Attachments: Speaker-Bio-Rishi.pdf, ScaleOps-Panel-Brief.pdf, Event-Schedule-v1.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@scaleops.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-16T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleOps Peer Forum — invite for Redwood as featured customer

Marissa — received, thanks for the assets. Confirming the details for the pre-brief on Tue Sep 23, 10:00 PT (Zoom link below). Moderator questions attached to this message; we’ll aim to share final run order a week out.

Zoom: https://scaleops.zoom.us/j/9876543210
Moderator-Questions:
1) Can you walk us through the decision to move to dedicated inference and the specific business trigger?
2) What changes in observability/ops were required to sustain production traffic?
3) Can you quantify the latency/cost impact post-migration?
4) One thing you would do differently next time?

We’ll also take care of travel for a single speaker (Rishi) — please confirm preferred travel dates and any dietary restrictions for the day of the event.

Looking forward — Sam
